comment: Kept outside resources/data, which a build's files leave out (ArchonEngine ControlPanel reads this from the build). The seasonal and special events this fork has built, for server/game_events.rs and ArchonEngine ControlPanel's Events page. festival and phase are what retail's ZoneInit carried while the event ran; content_entries are the ContentEntry events that put a duty (ContentFinderCondition) in the Duty Finder, as retail's did; retail_start and retail_end are when retail ran it (Unix seconds, UTC; null: not over or not known). label is the festival's name in upstream's resources/data/festivals.yml (upstream's own wording, not the game's), for the page; the quests' and duties' names it reads from the game.

events.label: FFVII Gold Saucer Event
events.source: Connor's Chronofoil captures of 2026-11-03 to 11-09 and Bob's of 2026-10-29: ZoneInit's festivals [257, 256, 120], phases [0, 2, 0]; the Lodestone: from 2026-10-28 08:00 UTC until patch 8.0
